item.title: Tecnologo: Project “Advanced microscopy as a strategic infrastructure for the S4: development of skills and services funded by the Friuli Venezia Giulia Region Program FSE+ -. activity code 2026/13393/2 CUP J93C23001490008 (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-06 Fisiologia

Public call for the selection of 1 mid-level technician/technologist (tecnologo di II livello) for the Project “Advanced microscopy as a strategic infrastructure for the S4: development of skills and services” within the Department of Life Sciences at the University of Trieste. Selection is based on the evaluation of the applicants’ academic qualifications and professional experience, and on an interview. This is a fixed-term 36 months, full-time position. Academic recruitment field: Scientific-disciplinary sector BIOS-06/A Physiology funded by the Friuli Venezia Giulia Region Program FSE+ -. activity code 2026/13393/2 CUP J93C23001490008
